title: rpg magic
description: adds rpg like magic using vanilla resources
body:
I wanted to make a magic mod that felt like it was actually apart of the game, so far there is only 3 spell books out(the names aren't permanent).
## Fire Book
![fire book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e166ac10b0a90b69914d898e2e03e86b215363b2_0.webp)\
a simple fire spell that sets mobs and blocks on fire.
## Firestorm Book
![firestorm book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1175c6e809508dd015b95daf572ba5e8750ad69.png) \
rains fire on where the user shoots.
## Explosion Book
![explosion book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b29bc70d8faa7b4b4efa13841b5f1886b7e4cb73_0.webp) \
sends an explosive shot in the user's choice.

# Recipes
The current recipes are just placeholders, I plan to add more depth and journy to getting spell books. \
![fire book recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8e25304cd0a642cc39c622d295f662bd51c3adb.png) \
